clue.text: Start to repair damage, having overturned the chessboard?

definitions.meaning: to begin restoring things after a disaster or setback
literally, gathering the knights, pawns and bishops scattered across the floor

explanation.surface: A sore loser flips the board and must now set things right.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to recover after trouble, and literally describes gathering fallen chessmen.

clue.text: Had run posthaste, perhaps, to make the collection

indicators.note: perhaps signals the letters of these three words might be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: Someone dashed off in a hurry to gather donations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' is the anagram signal for all fifteen letters of HAD RUN POSTHASTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: circulating a cap so people drop in money is taking up a collection.

clue.text: Ship: a cutter?

definitions.meaning: something that clips, such as shears; a cutter is also a kind of boat, which helps the misdirection

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a swift sailing vessel and a tool for trimming hair or nails.

clue.text: Encourage to take a little courgette

indicators.note: a little of the word courgette means only part of its letters is taken

explanation.surface: A child is coaxed into trying a bite of vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to press or spur someone on.

clue.text: Dismiss those attending meeting

definitions.meaning: to expel or evict, as from a house
the number of people present at a gathering

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to eject someone; as a noun it is attendance at an event.

clue.text: Alluring person, one in recent difficulty

indicators.note: in means the numeral letter goes inside the rearranged word
difficulty suggests the word recent is in a muddle, its letters disordered

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A charmer finds themselves in a fresh spot of bother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'difficulty' rearranges RECENT to ENTCER, and 'in' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: One who tempts or lures others is a seducer or tempter.

clue.text: One on a holy island

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
taken as written

explanation.surface: A lone pilgrim sets foot on a sacred isle.
explanation.walkthrough: IONA is a small Hebridean island off western Scotland where St Columba founded a monastery.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Scottish isle is a famous early Christian site.

clue.text: Chests-sounds like people having trouble with them

indicators.note: sounds like says the word spoken resembles the entry when heard

parts.note: people with chest trouble are coughers, them being their chests

explanation.surface: Treasure boxes are named after those suffering from chest complaints.
explanation.walkthrough: 'them' refers back to chests in the body sense: people with bad chests cough.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: strongboxes for holding money or valuables.

clue.text: How, proverbially, peace may prove very expensive?

definitions.text: How, proverbially, peace may prove very expensive?

parts.words: How, proverbially, peace may prove very expensive?
parts.note: peace means quiet, and the proverb says quiet is worth the costliest metal

explanation.surface: A wry note that peace comes at a high price.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb praises keeping quiet by likening it to a precious metal.

clue.text: Trapeze artist perhaps is a lively person

definitions.meaning: an acrobat who sways on a bar, one example

explanation.definitionFit: The word means one who sways on a bar and also a trendy pleasure-seeker.

clue.text: Such music may involve a lot of strain

definitions.text: Such music may involve a lot of strain

parts.words: Such music may involve a lot of strain
parts.note: strain here is a melody, so music full of them is melodious

explanation.surface: Some music is hard work to perform.
explanation.definitionFit: Being full of melodies, or strains, means melodious.

clue.text: Record as army volunteers to take exercise

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
PE is physical education

explanation.surface: Reservists are logged as they head off for a workout.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is the Territorial Army, the British Army's part-time volunteer reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to capture sound or video on a recording medium.

clue.text: Young bounder may be in pocket here

definitions.text: Young bounder may be in pocket here

parts.words: Young bounder may be in pocket here
parts.note: a bounder is a cad, but here a leaping joey carried in its mother's pocket

explanation.surface: A young cad might be cashed up here.
explanation.definitionFit: A marsupial's abdominal pocket holds its young joey.

clue.text: Piercing lamentation

definitions.meaning: sharp or penetrating, as an icy wind
an Irish wailing dirge for the dead

explanation.definitionFit: The word means sharp, and also an Irish funeral wail.

clue.text: Wager about soldiers' cap

indicators.note: about means the bet goes round the soldiers

parts.note: a wager is a bet
RE is the Royal Engineers, British Army soldiers

explanation.surface: A bet involving the headgear worn by troops.
explanation.walkthrough: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a soft round flat hat, typical of some military units.

clue.text: Games wear

definitions.meaning: to display or have on, as a badge

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers athletic activity, and as a verb means to wear proudly.

clue.text: Pledge to give attention to home

parts.note: lending an ear is giving attention
a nest is a bird's home

explanation.surface: A promise to look after the household.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a deposit paid as a token of good faith.

clue.text: Quick answer from letter I posted

indicators.note: from means the entry is taken out of a run of the following words

explanation.surface: A swift reply comes back to something mailed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a quick, witty retort.

clue.text: Elbow-room for Mafia leader in detention?

indicators.note: in means the initial goes inside the word for detention

parts.note: an arrest is detention by police

indicators.note: leader indicates the first letter of Mafia

explanation.surface: A mob boss in custody gets some space.
explanation.definitionFit: Punning: a support where an elbow lies, literally a room for an elbow.

clue.text: 10 makes me look detectives up

parts.note: lo is an archaic call meaning look

indicators.note: up, in a down clue, means detectives is read from bottom to top

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department

explanation.surface: Something makes me ask the police to investigate.
explanation.walkthrough: '10' refers to 10-across, TUNEFUL. 'up' turns CID into DIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym of the referenced answer: both mean musical and pleasing in tune.

clue.text: Slip up and spill oil in port

parts.note: to slip up is to trip

indicators.note: spill signals the letters of oil are scattered

explanation.surface: Someone stumbles and sends oil flowing at a harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spill' rearranges OIL into OLI. TRIPOLI is the Libyan capital and seaport.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a Libyan city on the Mediterranean, with a harbour.

clue.text: Conducts car-trips round the East

indicators.note: round means the trips enclose the compass point

parts.note: drives are car trips
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: Someone leads motoring tours around the Orient.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conducts' looks to govern car-trips, but it is the definition in the old sense of channelling water from a source.
explanation.definitionFit: Old sense: to channel or lead something, such as water, from its origin.

clue.text: Water shortage hurt dog terribly

indicators.note: terribly suggests the words are badly mixed up

explanation.surface: A dog suffers from lack of water.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a prolonged lack of rainfall.

clue.text: Forceful note received a by plant

indicators.note: received means the plant takes in the note

parts.note: a violet is a flowering plant
N for note, a common abbreviation

explanation.surface: A strongly worded memo is taken in by a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: marked by great force or intensity.

clue.text: River badly described as small brook

parts.note: ill means badly, as in ill-treated

explanation.surface: A poorly described waterway.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a tiny stream or rivulet.

clue.text: Collier said this is not very important

indicators.note: said means the clue word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a collier is a coal miner

explanation.surface: A coal worker declares something trivial.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: of lesser significance.

clue.text: Double act got the bird in the old days

definitions.text: the bird in the old days

indicators.note: double means the word for act is written twice

parts.note: to do is to act

explanation.surface: A comedy duo got a raspberry long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'got the bird' hints at a booed act, but the bird is the definition: extinct, so of the old days.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a flightless Mauritian creature, extinct since the 1600s.

clue.text: Black line seen over eye

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
a row is a line

explanation.surface: A dark streak sits above someone's eye.
explanation.definitionFit: The forehead or eyebrow sits above the eye.

clue.text: Drink, raking in a profit

indicators.note: raking in means the drink gathers up the article

parts.note: gin is a spirit, a drink

explanation.surface: A bar is raking in money from spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an increase in wealth or earnings.

clue.text: Experience change urged on

indicators.note: change signals the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is pushed to go through a transformation.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to go through or suffer something.

clue.text: Portuguese colony leader is progressive

parts.note: Goa was a Portuguese colony in India
a head is a leader

explanation.surface: The head of a former colony is forward-thinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: enterprising and keen on new ideas.

clue.text: The Lord Mayor's Show?

parts.note: a London parade, but read as a Christmas show about a famous Lord Mayor

explanation.surface: London's annual civic parade.
explanation.walkthrough: The pantomime, a British Christmas stage show, tells of a poor boy with a cat who became Lord Mayor of London.
explanation.definitionFit: A pantomime about a medieval London mayor is a show about that office.
